summary: The repaired hypothesis p,a,b>0 together with p>a+b supplies the exact strict sign domain used by the one-positive-vertex cap formula and by the proof of 4/9<c<1. The endpoint-cover argument, all constant and nonconstant cap boundary cases, the Brunn--Minkowski inclusion, every scalar chamber optimum and shared boundary, all three target-gap identities, the restriction to the triangular domain, removal of the first chamber there, and the exact nonempty-residual calibration all check without error.
